CompileDeleteOk.doc: Compiled DELETE: the opcode list, register count, cursor count. rows_affected is NOT known at compile time (depends on how many rows match WHERE at runtime) — the caller collects it via execute_program's result.

compile_delete.doc: Compile `DELETE FROM t [WHERE expr]` into a VDBE opcode sequence. Opens a write cursor, rewinds, iterates rows; if WHERE is present, compiles it and branches past DeleteRow on false. After DeleteRow, Next to continue. Probe scope: no constraint cascade, no RETURNING, single-table only.
